entries.text: #I am Dytto, a water spirit.<01>Water has the power to purify<01>and can wash away evil.#<07>#I swear that I am devoted to<01>my master.#<07>#I will come to serve you when<01>I see the light ball on the<01>surface of the water.#
#Hi, Ali!#
#Hi, Ali.  What kind of junk<01>did you dig up today?#
#Digging in the mud again, Ali?<01>Excavations, you say?  What's<01>the difference?#
#Oh, Ali.  Nice armlet.  Where'd<01>you find it?#
#Prince Ali, are you all right?<01>I don't know who they were,<01>but you were their target.#<07>#They may have attacked the<01>castle as well.  You must check<01>on your family.#
#Ali, I have a special today!<01>Why don't you take a look?#
Ali defeated the hostile group<01>which attacked him, and<01>hurried to see his teacher.
He found Dytto, a spirit of<01>water who had been sleeping in<01>the Water Shrine.
#Efreet is my name.  I am fire<01>which burns away anything<01>unclean.  The Gold Armlet is<01>my master.#
#Hey, take me to the ruins next<01>time!  Please!#
#There have been many strangers<01>around here lately.  I don't<01>like them.#
#I appear from the void to<01>become your shadow.  My name is<01>Shade.#<07>#I pledge my allegiance to you,<01>Gold Armlet.  You may summon me<01>from your own reflection.#
#I'm Bow!  You are my master.<01>I can be found inside plants.<01>Call me when there's lots to<01>eat!#
He found Efreet, a spirit of<01>fire who had been sleeping<01>in the Waterfall Shrine.
He captured the enemy base and<01>sneaked onto a ship staying in<01>the harbor.
Ali defeated the gargoyles.  He<01>headed his boat in the direction<01>where Silver Armlet disappeared.
He defeated the monsters in the<01>cave and picked up a necklace<01>which had a mysterious radiance.
He left for the wall fortress<01>to continue after Silver Armlet.
He defeated the monsters in the<01>fortress and got the Warp<01>Device.
He defeated the old dragon<01>in the crater and found Shade,<01>a spirit of shadow in the Shrine<01>of Darkness.
#It is said that there is a<01>hidden Shrine where a Spirit<01>sleeps.  Ali, go up along the<02>river to find the Shrine.#
He found Bow, a spirit of plants<01>who had been sleeping in Forest<01>Shrine.
The stream lead into a<01>dungeon under the castle.
He obtained the Large Cube.
#Ali, did you find out who they<01>are?  It is our responsibility<01>to deal with these rebels.#
Ali defeated the monster in<01>the non-entity, and fell into<01>a depth of darkness...

Many ages ago, a devastating<01>battle was waged in the<01>shadowlands of the Kingdom of<01>Oasis.  It was between two<01>powerful sorcerers, Reharl and<01>Agito.<02><06>Both sorcerers drew special<01>powers from their magical<01>Armlets.  Reharl used his Gold<01>Armlet to govern the spirits.<01>Agito used his Silver Armlet to<01>create chaos and destruction.<02><06>The epic battle destroyed them<01>both.  The Armlets were<01>presumed to be lost as well.<02><06>
#Ali, I am calling to you.<01>Please, pick me up.#

#I am what remains of this Gold<01>Armlet.  I now entrust its<01>power to you, for you have been<01>chosen to undergo a difficult<01>task.#<02><02><02><06>#The Gold Armlet has its pair:<01>a Silver Armlet, which has<01>possessed the soul of another.<01>He will lead Oasis to ruin if<01>you do not stop him.#<02><02><02><06>#The powers of the Gold Armlet<01>are now yours to wield.#<02><02><02><06>#Find the four spirits this<01>Gold Armlet governs, and stop<01>the evil ambition of the one<01>with the Silver Armlet.#
#Prince Ali, good luck!#
#Ali, have you been to the Water<01>Shrine? Go to the east through<01>the village.  The Spirit is a<02>trustworthy partner for you.#
#My master, Gold Armlet, show<01>me your light ball.#
#Prince Ali!  Welcome back!#
#The King and the Princess are<01>waiting for you in the main<01>hall up the stairs.#
#Ali, please go and read the<01>books hidden in the back room<01>before you go.  I'm sure they<01>will help you.#

#Welcome back, my son!  Let me<01>see what you found.#<07>#Hmmm, I've heard this story<01>before...if this is really the<01>Gold Armlet, then IT was the<01>reason for that strange attack<02>today.#<07>#The Gold Armlet governs the<01>wild spirits.  Ali, go find the<01>spirit sleeping in the Water<01>Shrine.#

#So you found the Water Spirit?<01>Then the story must be true!#<07>#I have instructed the soldiers<01>to find out who these strangers<01>are.  I will receive a report<01>sometime later.#<07>#Ali, you must go to the East<01>Waterfall before the soldiers<01>come back.  There must be<01>another Shrine where a spirit<02>sleeps.  Find it to fulfill<01>your destiny.#
#Ali, the soldiers reported<01>that some strange groups are<01>camped out in the field<01>northeast of the Water Shrine.#<07>#You must investigate the area<01>before they hurt the<01>villagers.#
#Gold Armlet, you are brave to<01>come here.  But unfortunately, I<01>have no time to fool with you.#<07>#I am Silver Armlet.  You cannot<01>stop me, and you will be sorry<01>you tried!#
He caught a faint conversation<01>from downstairs.<07>#...is it to the north?#<07>#Yes, in the wall fortress.<01>It is the key to go to the<01>west crater to see Shade...#
#Ali, what did you dig up<01>today?#
#Ali, it's you!  It has been a<01>long time!  Did you find<01>anything interesting?#
#Are you all right, Ali?  I saw<01>a strange group in the village<01>and I was worried about you.<02>It's not safe to wander around<01>outside.#
#I have not seen you lately,<01>Ali.  Where have you been?#
#Hello, Ali.  Do excavations<01>still interest you?#

#You've caught up with me much<01>earlier than I expected.  Well,<01>let me reward you.#<07>#Somewhere in this castle, there<01>is a device which can move you<01>through a warp of time and<01>space.  I don't need it, but<02>you will.#<07>#Show me your power, Gold<01>Armlet.  You must defeat my<01>minions to gain access to<01>the Warp Device!#
#Welcome, Prince.  Yes, I know<01>everything.  This is yours.<01>That ring is a great help to<01>you.#

#The necklace you found belongs<01>to Princess Gwyn, your elder<01>sister.#<07>#As you know, she's been missing<01>for over ten years.  This may<01>mean she is still alive.#<07>#Now, go back to the castle.<01>Silver Armlet wants something<01>from inside it, and you must<01>hurry to protect your family.#
#It was a sudden attack!  Is the<01>King all right?#
#The underground passage there<01>leads to the dungeons of the<01>castle, but the entrance is<01>blocked by a grille.#
#My grandpa said that there is<01>a Shrine in the northeast<01>forest.  Inside it is a monster<01>that eats up anything!#
#Go north once past the East<01>Gate.  You will find a large<01>cave in the mountain.#
#Ali!#

#Ha-ha-ha!  Hello, Gold Armlet.<01>I'll trade you a Princess for a<01>Large Cube hidden somewhere<01>inside this castle.#<07>#Come to Mt. Allat with the<01>Large Cube and I will trade you<01>for your younger sister.#
#You broke my Seal.  I am the<01>origin of Agito's power and the<01>keeper of his soul.  His ancient<01>evil can be awakened by me.#

#Oh, Ali...it's you.#<07>#You found the Large Cube?<01>It is evil, and I hoped it<01>would never be recovered from<01>the dungeon.#<07>#Ali, you must do what you<01>think is right.  We...we are<01>all counting on you...#
#Prince Ali, we will get to<01>the cave as soon as we can.#
#Love is beautiful, isn't it?<01>Ha-ha-ha!  Give me the Large<01>Cube first.#
Good.  Now the Princess is<01>yours.  Take care of your<01>precious sister, she tends to<01>get lost easily!#

#I'm sorry, you were unable<01>to do anything against that<01>foul creature because of<01>me...#<07>#I know that nothing I can<01>say will stop you from<01>following, but...#<07>#Please take this for good luck.<01>Come back safe and sound, Ali.#
#Prince!  Princess!  Are you<01>all right?  It's dangerous<01>around here.  Please go back<01>to the castle, Princess.#
#Welcome to the non-entity,<01>Gold Armlet.#<07>#This is the border between<01>the shadow and the human<01>world.#<07>#You cannot use the Armlet's<01>power here.  This is the end<01>of your journey!#
#I have been waiting for you.#<07>#It's been an interesting<01>game...but now it's time to<01>finish it.  You cannot stop<01>the revival of the Creator<02>of the Silver Armlet, my<01>master, Agito!#
#Well done.  I must reward you<01>for your persistence, Gold<01>Armlet!#<07>#I reward you with your death!#
#You...won.  I misjudged your<01>superior...abilities.#<07>#But...you will not defeat<01>Agito.  He has returned to<01>resume his throne!#
#Oh...oh...It's you, Ali.<01>It's me, your elder sister,<01>Gwyn.#<07>#I...heard your voice...<01>but...I could do nothing...<01>I was possessed.#<07>#Finally, I got back my...<01>my...memories.#
#I feel the power filling the<01>world.  Thank you, my master,<01>Gold Armlet.  You saved our<01>world.#
#But now we must remain here.#
#I am proud to have both fought<01>for you and beside you.  You<01>shall be remembered forever.#
#Bow had fun time! Now this<01>Warp will bring you home.<01>Good-bye, friend Ali!#

#Ali...wait.#<07>#I destroyed things and killed<01>people...#<07>#Even though I was possessed<01>and controlled...I must make<01>atonement for my sin.#<07>#Ali, tell this to everyone.<01>Agito and the Silver Armlet<01>minion have been destroyed<01>forever.  They will never<02>endanger Oasis again.#
#Now, let me say good-bye...<01>and...thank you...my brother.#
#Big Attack/Small Attack#<02>Press or tap Button B to attack<01>the enemies.  Ali jumps when<01>C button is tapped, and<01>ducks when Button C is held.
#Run#<02>Ali runs to the direction of the<01>D-Pad.  Ali jumps when Button<01>C is tapped, and ducks when<01>Button C is held.
#Spin Attack#<02>One of the special attacks with<01>a dagger.  D-Pad Forward, Left,<01>Back, Right + Button B held.
#Rolling Slash#<02>A special attack with the<01>dagger.<01>D-Pad Forward, Back, Forward<01>+ Button B held.
#Double Rolling Slash#<02>Enhanced attack of #Rolling<01>Slash#.
#Chaotic Sword Slash#<02>A special attack with a sword.<01>D-Pad Forward, Left, Back,<01>Right, Forward, Back, Forward +<01>Button B held.

Instructions<07>#Magic Bubble#<01>Tap Button A to generate a<01>bubble that stuns enemies.<07>#Healing#<01>Tap Button A twice.<07>#Magic Storm#<01>Hold Button A for 1 second<01>to attack all enemies with<01>a water tornado.<07>Press A,B and C buttons together<01>to cancel the summons

Instructions<07>#Flame Breath#<01>Tap Button A to create<01>a stream of fiery breath.<07>#Fireball Attack#<01>Tap Button A twice to turn<01>Efreet into a fireball.<07>#Melt Bomber#<01>Hold Button A for 1 second<01>to cause a fire inundation.<07>Press A,B and C buttons together<01>to cancel the summons

Instructions<07>#Dark Claw#<01>Tap Button A.  Shade attacks<01>enemies with his claws.<02>Also can be used to grapple<01>out of reach items.<07>#Doppelganger#<01>Hold Button A for 1 second<01>to generate a duplicate which<01>can move around the area.<02>Ali becomes invincible.<07>Press A,B and C buttons together<01>to cancel the summons

Instructions<07>#Bite Attack#<01>Tap Button A to make Bow bite<01>his enemies.<07>#Move Underground#<01>Tap Button A twice to call Bow<01>to where Ali is standing.<01>Bow moves underground silently.<07>#Poison Pollen#<01>Hold Button A for 1 second.<01>Bow blows up, scattering<01>poison pollen which stuns<02>the enemies.<07>Press A,B and C buttons together<01>to cancel the summons
#You have something nice, Ali.<01>Give it to me in return for <01>this, okay?#
#Ali, you sure showed them!#
#Thank you, Ali.#
#What unsafe days!#
#I'm so afraid...I cannot go out<01>alone.#
#Prince Ali.  I'm relieved to<01>see you safe! Have you returned<01>to your castle yet?#<07>#The King and the Princess must<01>be worried about you.#
#What was that?#
#Teach me how to use a dagger<01>next time, okay?#
#Too many strange things happen<01>these days!#
#Prince Ali, I pray for your<01>safety.  Be careful.#
#My bubbles can open this water<01>gate, master.#
#I trust the soldiers guarding<01>the castle.  Please be<01>careful, brother.#
#Father is very worried about<01>you...I am too.  Take care<01>and come back safe and sound.#
I know you're very tough,<01>but I'm still so worried.<01>Please, please be careful.
